design.objective: Unify the version type, application characteristic, and status columns as compact semantic tags without changing business behavior.
users: Configuration-management users scanning the release application list

requirements.statement: All three columns must use compact tags with consistent dimensions and alignment.
acceptance: All three columns render through UiStatusTag

requirements.statement: Existing semantic colors for version type and status must remain unchanged.
acceptance: Version and status tones retain current mappings

requirements.statement: Application characteristic must display 普通申请 or 追加申请 as a semantic tag.
acceptance: 普通申请 uses info tone
追加申请 uses warning tone

requirements.statement: The presentation change must not alter release application data or behavior.
acceptance: No API, state, filter, permission, or backend changes

invariants: Version and status tone functions remain unchanged
constraints: Modify only the release application list presentation
Remain on rokey and do not commit or push

selected_approach.name: Unified semantic tags
selected_approach.reason: It removes mixed text and tag presentation with the existing component.

components.name: UiStatusTag
components.responsibility: Provide the existing small plain semantic tag.

interfaces.name: Release application row presentation
interfaces.contract: Presentation mappings do not mutate row data.

error_handling.behavior: Render 普通申请 with info tone.
Verify single-line fit before changing width.
error_handling.recovery: Escalate if a broader layout change is required.

verification_strategy.signal: Three columns show aligned confirmed labels and tones.
Build passes and scope remains local.
verification_strategy.method: Production build, scoped diff, and whitespace check.

assumptions.text: The scope is only the three columns shown in the list screenshot.
assumptions.basis: The user referenced the left and right neighboring columns.

decisions.decision: Display 普通申请 instead of 普通.

risks.risk: 普通申请 may be tight in a 100px column.
risks.mitigation: Use the existing small tag and verify in browser.

approval.evidence: The user confirmed design revision one on 2026-08-20.

global_constraints: No data, API, backend, public component, commit, or push changes
Preserve existing version and status mappings

file_map.evidence: Current three columns are co-located in the table template
Already consumed by the adjacent columns

tasks.goal: Unify the three table semantics as aligned compact tags.
input_facts: Version type and status already use UiStatusTag
Application characteristic mixes el-tag and bare text

steps.expected: The current mixed tag and bare-text rendering is found

steps.action: Replace only the characteristic cell with UiStatusTag
steps.expected: Both characteristic values use the confirmed label and tone while adjacent mappings remain unchanged
Exit 0 and no unrelated product file changes from this task
steps.evidence: Command result and target source assertion

steps.action: Inspect representative tag combinations in the browser
steps.expected: Labels align, colors match semantics, no clipping or new console errors

acceptance_checks: 普通申请 and 追加申请 use info and warning tones
Existing version and status mappings remain
risks: Four-character ordinary label may be tight in the current column
tasks.rollback: Restore only the original characteristic-cell template in ReleaseApplicationView.vue.
stop_conditions: A global component or multi-column layout change becomes necessary
escalation_conditions: The user requests expansion to other pages or a color-mapping change

approval.evidence: The user explicitly confirmed direct development from implementation plan revision one on 2026-08-20.

actuator_candidates: Characteristic-cell UiStatusTag label and tone bindings

assumptions.text: A local template change is sufficient.
assumptions.basis: Adjacent columns already use UiStatusTag successfully.
assumptions.falsifier: Browser evidence shows clipping that requires a broader layout change.
